Ability.Name: -- Motor MRC --
Ability.Lua: if not MRC then MRC={} MRC.Book={} function MRC.Refresh() MRC.Book={} if not GetSpellName then return end for i=1,300 do local n=GetSpellName(i,BOOKTYPE_SPELL); if not n then break end; MRC.Book[n]=true end end MRC.Refresh() MRC.EventFrame=CreateFrame("Frame") MRC.EventFrame:RegisterEvent("SPELLS_CHANGED") MRC.EventFrame:SetScript("OnEvent",function() MRC.Refresh() end) function MRC.Known(n) return MRC.Book and MRC.Book[n]==true end function MRC.Cast(n,aoe) if StopRota or not MRC.Known(n) then return false end if aoe and not IsShiftKeyDown() then return false end if UnitCastingInfo("player") or UnitChannelInfo("player") then return false end if not UnitExists("target") or UnitIsDeadOrGhost("target") or not IsUsableSpell(n) then return false end if not UnitCanAttack('player','target') then return false end local s,d=GetSpellCooldown(n) if s and d and d>1.6 and s+d>GetTime() then return false end local range=IsSpellInRange(n,"target"); if range==0 then return false end CastSpellByName(n); return true end end return false

Ability.Name: -- Control MRC --
Ability.Lua: if IsLeftControlKeyDown() and not MRC.ctrl then MRC.ctrl=true; StopRota=not StopRota; PQR_WriteToChat(StopRota and "MRC pausado" or "MRC activo") elseif not IsLeftControlKeyDown() then MRC.ctrl=false end; return false

Ability.Name: -- Golpe de la Plaga --
Ability.Lua: return MRC.Cast("Golpe de la Plaga", false)

Ability.Name: -- Espiral de la muerte --
Ability.Lua: return MRC.Cast("Espiral de la muerte", false)
